summary: YHN Acquisition I Ltd, a BVI-incorporated blank-check company, filed an 8-K after its September 14, 2026 annual general meeting where shareholders approved a Charter Amendment and Trust Amendment letting the board extend the business-combination deadline three times by three months each, from September 19, 2026 to June 19, 2027, at $100,000 per extension deposited into the trust. Holders of 4,285,821 shares were entitled to vote; 4,028,193 (about 93.99%) were represented. Watch for extension draws, trust yield, redemption levels, and any target announcement before June 2027.
